Thanks for the data, Anita — that's very helpful. Quick read-through and a preliminary technical plan before the scheduled deep-dive.

Key observations from your CSV (high-level):
- Observed p95 for interactive endpoint: ~760ms during peak; p50 ~120ms
- Token distribution confirms ~90 tokens median with 5% >1k tokens
- Background batch runs cause short concurrency spikes that push queuing downstream

Preliminary platform approach (what I'd propose we test in the POC):
- Model strategy: two-tier serving pool
  * Latency-critical pool: quantized 7B-class model (low-latency, GPU-optimized kernel) for interactive flows
  * Throughput pool: 13B-quant or 13B-8bit for background summarization (higher throughput, lower cost)
- Routing policy: prefix-aware routing + size-based sharding (requests > 800 tokens go to throughput pool by default)
- Caching: prefix KV caching for frequent user prompts and a small token-level prefix cache for session warmups (reduces hot-starts)
- Autoscaling: target SLO headroom 20% (scale at 70% utilization) with burst capacity via dedicated spare slots for scheduled batch windows
- Fallbacks: if latency pool is saturated, fallback to throughput pool with rate-limited async completion and a client-side hint to switch to background job mode

Preliminary sizing notes (ballpark until we profile with exact token histogram):
- To meet p95 <= 300ms for interactive at 85 concurrent sessions, we estimate a 4-GPU pool with continuous batching and KV cache tuned for 90-token median.
- For the batch summarization throughput, we estimate 6–8 GPUs depending on choice of 13B quant profile and target batch sizes.

Risks / questions to resolve in the deep-dive:
- Can you provide typical batch sizes and how long background windows last (minutes per window)?
- Are there hard SLAs for generating results synchronously for summarization jobs?
- Any preference on model families (we can run a short eval on your in-house classifier vs open-weights variants)

I'll prepare a short capacity estimate and cost delta (quantized vs full-precision) and upload it prior to the call (redwood_capacity_estimate.csv).

Would like to schedule the technical deep-dive for Tue 27 Apr at 10:30 PDT (30–60m). Laura and Grace will join to cover workload profiling and infra considerations.
